events.name: UserRegistered
events.description: Fired upon successful account creation with verified age >= 18.

events.name: UserDeleted
events.description: Fired when user deletes their account to purge personal data.

events.name: MatchCreated
events.description: Fired when two waiting peers are atomically paired together.

events.name: SessionStarted
events.description: Fired when WebRTC signaling handshake completes and peers enter active chat.

events.name: SessionEnded
events.description: Fired upon user skip, disconnect or grace timeout. Invalidates session token.

events.name: UserDisconnected
events.description: Fired when socket connection drops to trigger 15-second grace period.

events.name: UserReconnected
events.description: Fired when dropped peer reconnects before grace period expires.

events.name: ReportFiled
events.description: Fired when a user files a report against their partner.

events.name: BlockAdded
events.description: Fired when a user blocks another user to prevent future matches.

events.name: UserSuspended
events.description: Fired when moderator suspends an offending user.

events.name: UserBanned
events.description: Fired when moderator permanently bans an offending user.
